content.title: Letterform Motion System | Assembly, Structural Columns, Collision Lockup
content.summary: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins. Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier. Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure. Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling. Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.

quick_start.input_format: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins. + Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier. + Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure. + Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling. + Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
quick_start.recommended_input: On an off-white field with ink black and one cobalt accent only, scattered line segments spiral inward and assemble the exact primary title 'NORTH LAB'. Inside the rails, introduce only the exact words 'ORBIT', 'FIELD' and 'SIGNAL': ORBIT circles once, FIELD multiplies on a receding grid, SIGNAL slams front-on and stops. Clear the fragments, place exact 'LAB' above exact 'NORTH' with one cobalt rule between them, then stop background, ticks and foreground together for the final 1.2 seconds.

invariants.rule: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.
